why_now.title: It's been off since spring
why_now.text: Most OC heaters sit idle for eight months. Dust settles on the burners and small problems wait quietly for the first cold night.

why_now.title: Inland nights drop fast
why_now.text: Mission Viejo, Lake Forest and Yorba Linda can fall into the 40s after sunset, even when the afternoon felt like summer.

why_now.title: Older systems need a look
why_now.text: A lot of OC homes still run the furnace that came with the house. A quick inspection tells you where yours stands before you depend on it.

local: Orange County homes have a wide range of heating needs. In Huntington Beach and Newport Beach, damp marine-layer mornings make a cold house feel colder, while inland neighborhoods in Mission Viejo, Lake Forest and Yorba Linda see real winter nights in the 40s. Many homes here were built between the 1970s and 1990s, often with a furnace in the garage or attic that has never been replaced. We're new to OC but not to this work: the same crew and standards that built our name in San Diego.
faqs: What does the $29 furnace safety inspection cover?

A tech checks the parts of your furnace that matter most for safe operation: the burners and flame, the venting, the heat exchanger and the area around the unit for carbon monoxide. If we find something, we'll explain it and give you a written price before doing anything. See current specials for the terms.
Is carbon monoxide something I should worry about?

It's worth checking, not worrying about. A gas furnace that's venting properly and has a sound heat exchanger keeps combustion gases out of your home. The inspection confirms that, and if something isn't right we'll tell you plainly and talk through your options. A working CO detector near bedrooms is a good idea in any home with gas appliances.
Do you work on heat pumps too?

Yes. We repair and tune up heat pumps as well as gas furnaces. If your heat pump cools fine in summer but struggles to heat, that's a common call this time of year. Learn more on our heating services page.
Do you serve my part of Orange County?

We cover Orange County from San Clemente to Brea, including Irvine, Costa Mesa, Anaheim, Fullerton and Laguna Niguel. See the full list on our Orange County service area page, or call {{phone}} to check your address.
My furnace is old. Will you push me to replace it?

No. If your system is around 15 years or older, we'll tell you so and explain what we see, but the decision is yours. Plenty of older furnaces just need a repair and a tune-up. If replacement does make sense, we offer free estimates and financing.
